race.comment: SAVEUR (10) doesn't win out of turn but gets the nod off two eye-catching Eagle Farm thirds in stronger grades. She's a track and trip winner and gets the key booking of Thompson from the inside alley. If he can settle her a few pairs closer, she will take plenty of stitching. CRYPTION'S DESIRE (4) is knocking on the door and gets his chance to put it all together fourth-up with weight relief. Still has upside. SORRENTI (8) has been a touch patchy this prep but gets the blinkers on first time here to hopefully sharpen him up. Will need to be switched on from his low draw. TILL DUSK (2) looks ready for the rise in trip and reunites with gun hoop in Maloney. Worth some thought.
